sources.title: vwdubb/Swift-Qwen3.8-27b-FP8 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Swift-Qwen3.8-27B is UkisAI's reasoning-efficient derivative of Qwen3.8-27B, using 58.3% fewer thinking tokens while maintaining near-identical performance (<1% loss) and as a result getting a x1.95 speed-up on several tasks.

sources.title: Swift-Qwen3.8-27B: less overthinking | UkisAI
sources.snippet: Swift includes a transfer component derived from BottleCap AI's ThinkingCap-Qwen3.6-27B. The resulting model uses the standard Qwen3.8 interface and retains text, image, and video support.

sources.title: Swift Qwen3.8 27b - GGUF Model (3 parts) - local-ai-zone.github.io
sources.snippet: Download Swift Qwen3.8 27b GGUF model. 170.1 GB, 402,026 downloads, 454 likes. Split into 3 parts.

sources.title: GitHub - AlibabaCloud-Official/Qwen3.8-27B: Native multimodal dense LLM ...
sources.snippet: Welcome to the repository for Qwen3.8-27B —the latest native multimodal dense open-weight model released by Alibaba's Qwen team. Delivering top-tier performance for local hardware, Qwen3.8-27B excels at coding, agentic workflows, and office automation tasks.

sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MathVision: Qwen3.8-27B is evaluated using the fixed prompt: "Please reason step by step, and put your final answer within \boxed {}." For the remaining models, we report the higher score from two prompt variants—one with and one without the \boxed {} formatting requirement.
